responsibility: This header defines GCC’s simple dense bitmap type and its inline access/iteration interface. It describes the simple_bitmap_def storage layout, bit-width macros, checked bit test/set/clear operations, the sbitmap_iterator and EXECUTE_IF_SET_IN_BITMAP traversal macro, RAII helper auto_sbitmap, and declarations for the non-inline allocation, boolean, range, counting, dumping, and vector operations implemented in sbitmap.cc.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the interface for the sbitmap facility, defining the simple_bitmap_def layout, macros, inline bit operations/iteration, and auto_sbitmap wrapper, while gcc/sbitmap.cc supplies the non-inline algorithms, allocation/resizing logic, dump routines, and selftests.
